verdict: clear: global title lookup is separated from browsing and retains provider-aware results, cursors and focus
reviewed_paths: provider/id result identity and returned focus
notes: Main handler delivery is asynchronous; callbacks re-read the active handle snapshot and reject old query, background and detail views.
Each source keeps its own cursor; failed-page retries preserve successful results and cancellation only resumes interrupted requests.
Real provider identity reaches cards, detail and playback; category identifiers are not sent to global search.
Aggregate results are bounded and limits explicit; source and category browsing, local history/favorites and live channel queries remain available.
The home only pauses background search on detail/background and does not change the playback core, 4K ranking or provider registry.
